summary: User reports and moderation for CMS content. Any signed-in account reports a visible or archived item from its public page (/report/content/[id]) with one of seven reasons; not its own content, one open report per account per item (partial unique index) and a 24-hour limit read from the new MODERATION setting moderation.report_daily_limit. The content admin works a queue grouped by item (/content/reports) and decides on all open reports of an item at once: dismiss, request a correction, hide, soft-delete or restrict the publisher, always with a reason; each report records decision, reason, actor and time, and the change it causes is audited where it happens. Hide and soft delete run the CMS status rules inside the same transaction. A correction request keeps the content public, notifies the author and is closed by the author's next save. A publisher restriction stops the author publishing or changing public content (drafts stay editable) until its end date, decided at read time, or until lifted with a reason at /content/restrictions. Authors are notified of every decision except dismissal; reporters are never shown to the content admin or the author; a second simultaneous decision gets a conflict.

limitations: Reporters do not see the outcome of their reports; a 'my reports' page and outcome notification were not built.
Only content is reportable; vet, centre, association and club profiles join moderation_report with PROMPT-006, 008 and 010.
The independent review operator role of §3 is not built; content reports are handled by the content admin (DEC-0161).
A publisher restriction is recorded from an item's report page only; restricting an author without a report belongs to the admin panel (PROMPT-016).
Physical deletion is not built and waits for a data retention policy.
